疲労度が

records.speaker: Speakerless original546B8 system status
records.context: These are speakerless original546B8 system statuses after land search/expedition actions. Signed helper79728 exits for zero;otherwise34540 adds the signed input to current fleet fatigue at+3D and clamps the stored total to0..100. Positive input uses308;negative input uses309 with its positive magnitude. The message formats the requested change,not the new total and not a measured post-clamp difference. All original main/overlay ARM BL references to79728 are four constant call sites: oasis success-5,mirage failure+5,hot spring-15,and friendly-native event-10. A separate original foraging/search-failure branch79F90 adds+3 and directly invokes308 at79FB8. The original ABF50 formatter produces CP932 full-width decimal digits;one real source %s must be preserved. Known actual amounts are3,5,10,15. Values0..100 are CPU-only numeric layout stress,not additional real event values. No points/percent unit,currency,health outcome or actor relationship is supplied by these source messages. Original expedition dispatcher79BEC is called at7B18C after normal Search result2 and selects environmental callbacks through02119164 using original terrain/region/RNG. Hot-spring and mirage outcomes must not be forced to claim actual gameplay. Existing registered modal/literal-F/I hooks remain intact as verified in1572b;no new formatting or cursor code is proposed.
records.source_meaning: Fatigue increased by the supplied amount.
records.localization_note: Replace an unrelated split trade-good-description fragment with a complete,natural system message. Preserve exactly one original amount placeholder;do not turn the change into a total or invent percent,points,currency or health effects.
